title: chat-types: type Chat.activeCallId before 0.4 freeze
description: Freeze item from the second 2026-10-20 freeze review. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L567-576 defines Chat.activeCallId (String|null, server-set) as a core Chat property. jmap-chat-types Chat (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/chat.rs, struct Chat ~L154) has no typed field for it: grep -rn 'activeCallId\|active_call_id' crate-jmap-chat-*/src returns nothing. It survives only in Chat.extra (crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_server_set_fields.rs L32, L67-78 assert it is stored and rejected as a patch key). AGENTS.md L281-293 scopes extra to fields no spec declares. Adding the typed field after 0.4 is semver-additive (Chat is non_exhaustive) but moves the value out of extra, so a 0.4 consumer such as the VTC Chat binding (JMAP-8mem.6) that reads/writes chat.extra["activeCallId"] silently stops seeing it. Fix: add pub active_call_id: Option<Id> (serde activeCallId, default None) with a spec-quoted round-trip test; keep the server-set patch rejection. Supersedes the type half of JMAP-3m1s (P4, folded into JMAP-8mem).
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
